item_name: Rothco Vintage Fatigue Cap w/ Red Star
item_short_desc: Rothco’s Vintage Fatigue Cap w/ Red Star blends timeless style with comfortable functionality. This cap’s classic design is inspired by traditional uniform caps and features a bold red star on the front panel for a striking yet subtle statement. Its washed-out finish enhances the vintage aesthetic, making it a versatile accessory for everyday use.
